entities.name: Taishiar
entities.description: Recorder, far-seer and servant to Mezlok, a bipedal tailless griffin-like being able to track other wizards.

entities.name: Mezlok
entities.description: Taishiar's master who dueled in a contest of mages.

entities.name: Mirrankkar
entities.description: Plane where the contest of mages took place.

entities.name: Obsidias
entities.description: Plane where Taishiar and Mezlok ran into a rival.

events.summary: Taishiar guided Mezlok in a contest of mages on Mirrankkar.
events.quote: Taishiar guided his master Mezlok in a contest of mages on Mirrankkar

events.summary: After a run-in with a rival on Obsidias they arrived the day before the contest.
events.quote: Due to a run-in with a rival on Obsidias , they arrived the day before the contest

relations.quote: Taishiar was a recorder, a far-seer, and servant to Mezlok
